newsitem.title: JAPAN: ALPINE SKIING-RAINS FORCE DOWNHILL CANCELLATION.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-RAINS FORCE DOWNHILL CANCELLATION.

text.p: Heavy rain forced officials to cancel a World Cup womens downhill on Saturday, the third race on the courses for next years Nagano Winter Olympics ruined by weather.
The race, the second of two downhills scheduled to be held this week on the Mount Happoone course, will be run on Sunday if the weather clears, race officials said.

After forecasts earlier in the week called for worsening weekend weather, international ski officials urged Japanese organisers to hold two races on Friday, but they refused, citing sponsorship commitments.
Fridays race, won by Russias Varvara Zelenskaya, was held in warm, sunny conditions before the arrival of a cold front early on Saturday.
Last year heavy snow forced cancellation of two mens World Cup downhills at Hakuba.
